title: Finite scalar extension of the normalized dual-formula counit
statement: Fix the finite-field, morphism, compactification, normalized exceptional coefficient system S and finite coefficient fields F,G with embedding i, and coherent dualizing and rational Verdier data on X,Y over both fields [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image, def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. Supply two adjunctions for rational compact support and the respective dual formulas, satisfying DualFormulaAdjunctionNormalized [lem-sf-rational-dual-formula-adjunction], and normalized duality scalar comparisons eX,eY [def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. Write alpha for the S.rationalComparison.q map conjugated by the two S.rationalLeft isomorphisms. Write delta_M for beta_X followed by target duality applied to the composite of inverse beta_Y and inverse scalar/pullback comparison, in contravariant order. Then A_G(delta_M) followed by the target normalized counit equals alpha inverse at H_F(M), followed by scalar extension of the source normalized counit. No comparison from the exceptional right adjoint to a dual formula appears in this assertion.

source.place: lem-coef-rational-operations, original proof steps 19--20; localize the integral scalar-transpose identity

proof.text: Unpack the two normalized adjunctions. Apply the integral dual-formula scalar-transpose theorem to their integral adjunctions and tensor presentations. The identity satisfies FormulaNormalized, so uniqueness makes both formula isomorphisms identities. Cancel the faithful constructible inclusion and support realization to get the integral counit equation.

Identify the integral compact-support map with the coefficient-system map using integralLeft_normalized and comparison_normalized. These equations retain the ordinary proper/open comparison and both completion conjugations; no unrelated equality after finite evaluations is used.

Apply raw rational localization to that equation. Use the normalized counit HEqs and normalizedX/normalizedY, with the pure-map equations for duality and the prescribed pullback scalar comparison, to identify the localized composite with delta. The system rational_normalized equation identifies its support factor with alpha. Objects of raw rational localization are unchanged, so the resulting equation covers every M.

theorem rationalDualFormulaScalarCounit
    (wXF : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl F.carrier)
    (wYF : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l Y D hl F.carrier)
    (wXG : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl G.carrier)
    (wYG : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l Y D hl G.carrier)
    (DXF : RationalVerdier.Datum D l hl X F.carrier wXF)
    (DYF : RationalVerdier.Datum D l hl Y F.carrier wYF)
    (DXG : RationalVerdier.Datum D l hl X G.carrier wXG)
    (DYG : RationalVerdier.Datum D l hl Y G.carrier wYG)
    (adjF : sfCompactSupportFiniteFunctor l D.k
      (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit l D hl) c F.carrier ⊣
        dualFormula l X D hl (f := f) F wXF wYF DXF DYF)
    (adjG : sfCompactSupportFiniteFunctor l D.k
      (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit l D hl) c G.carrier ⊣
        dualFormula l X D hl (f := f) G wXG wYG DXG DYG)
    (hF : DualFormulaAdjunctionNormalized D l hl X c F wXF wYF DXF DYF adjF)
    (hG : DualFormulaAdjunctionNormalized D l hl X c G wXG wYG DXG DYG adjG)
    (eX : RationalVerdier.Extension D l hl X F.carrier G.carrier ι wXF wXG DXF DXG)
    (eY : RationalVerdier.Extension D l hl Y F.carrier G.carrier ι wYF wYG DYF DYG)
    (normalizedX : RationalVerdier.ExtensionProperties D l hl X F.carrier G.carrier ι
      wXF wXG DXF DXG eX)
    (normalizedY : RationalVerdier.ExtensionProperties D l hl Y F.carrier G.carrier ι
      wYF wYG DYF DYG eY)
    (M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l F.carrier Y) :
    let alpha :=
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (S.ring.rationalLeft c F).symm
          (RationalVerdier.scalar l Y F.carrier G.carrier ι) ≪≫
        (S.fields.rationalComparison c F G ι).q ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (RationalVerdier.scalar l X F.carrier G.carrier ι)
          (S.ring.rationalLeft c G)
    let delta :=
      eX.comparison.hom.app (op
          ((@rationalDerivedPullback l _ F.carrier _ _ _ X Y f
            (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (RationalVerdier.units D l hl Y)).obj
              (DYF.dual.obj (op M)))) ≫
        DXG.dual.map
          (((@rationalDerivedPullback l _ G.carrier _ _ _ X Y f
              (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (RationalVerdier.units D l hl Y)).map
                (eY.comparison.inv.app (op M)) ≫
            (@rationalPullbackScalarComparison l _ F.carrier _ _ _ G.carrier _ _ _ ι X Y f
              (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (RationalVerdier.units D l hl Y)).inv.app
                (DYF.dual.obj (op M))).op)
    (sfCompactSupportFiniteFunctor l D.k
        (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit l D hl) c G.carrier).map
          delta ≫
      adjG.counit.app ((RationalVerdier.scalar l Y F.carrier G.carrier ι).obj M) =
    alpha.inv.app ((dualFormula l X D hl (f := f) F wXF wYF DXF DYF).obj M) ≫
      (RationalVerdier.scalar l Y F.carrier G.carrier ι).map (adjF.counit.app M)
